title: Quietly Simmered Argentinian Genmaicha Bowl
description: A buttery and crumbly Argentinian dish featuring genmaicha, simmered to perfection in a Korean brass bowl, suitable for a shojin-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat the sesame oil in a Korean brass bowl over low heat.
Add the unsalted butter and let it melt, stirring occasionally.
Add the argentinian corn flour and stir until it is well combined with the butter and oil.
Add the genmaicha tea and stir until it is well coated with the flour mixture.
Add the korean chili flakes and salt, and stir until they are well combined.
Add the water and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let it simmer for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the bowl from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the quietly simmered genmaicha mixture in the Korean brass bowl.
